basic_info.description: An outer sunset gem with the friendliest neighbors, qualifies as a Great Neighborhood! This Home was recently painted on the outside and new roof . The Layout features a bright and spacious living room with distinctive fireplace, stylish sky-lit kitchen with ample cabinetry, gas stove and built in microwave. 2 spacious bedrooms with plenty of closet space and a bathroom with stall shower and tub. Possibilities! Downstairs is an additional versatile room  approximately 12 x 16 and a full bath perfect as 3rd bedroom, home office, guest room, creative space, or a safe child's play area. Open garage area with 1 car. Storage shelves, Washing Machine and Dryer are included.  Great opportunity to create your dream home, grab it before it's gone!
